data.aligned_note: Teacher generated by the same switched Mirror family but with independent physical coefficients; positive-control only
data.independent_note: Teacher generated by independently initialized native MLPs at each step; no fitted Mirror teacher

architecture.decoder: orthogonal seed transform; once per functional step z <- z + 0.16 Q(step)^T tanh(Q(step)z+b(step)); generated virtual MLPS with first tanh

training.loss: normalized mean squared error on final output residual

measurement.rules: Checkpoint + source SHA256 + separate audit data; no fresh retuning

gate.quality: At T=4 across independent teachers, switch improves >=5% relative NMSE against best tied/same/linear/gain control in >=2/3 seeds at comparable physical bytes; no claim against untied unless supported
gate.capacity: not established by fixed 240 updates; report only finite-update learning efficiency
gate.runtime: report CPU only, no GPU extrapolation

environment.hardware: capture at run time; clock not fixed

limitations: small d=8 MLP and two synthetic teacher families
transformed virtual weights generated every forward; not GPU fused
fixed Mirror codes count as algorithm/program information
